notes: New: Library is now Music, with real music-player features - tap a song and the rest of your library keeps playing after it instead of stopping, plus Play all and Shuffle buttons, Repeat (off/one/all), sorting by title/artist/album/date added/duration, and browsing by Album, Artist, or Folder. Fixed: a stray 'Clear filters' button could show up on TV after using the state filter on Radio, and a TalkBack filter chip no longer reads its 'double tap' hint twice.
